Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Swarana Kanta Sharma
 Order

By way of the present petition, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR bearing no. 450/2016,
registered at Police Station Govindpuri, South East District, New Delhi, for the commission of offence punishable under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter 'IPC')
and subsequent proceedings arising out of the said FIR.

entities.text: Police Station Govindpuri, South East District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. Issue notice.
The learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.

3. Petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 are present before this Court and have been identified by their counsels and concerned Investigating Officer (IO) from Police Station Govindpuri, South East District, New Delhi.

entities.text: Police Station Govindpuri, South East District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 4. Brief facts of the present case are that the marriage between petitioner no. 1 and respondent no. 2 was solemnized on 10.10.2017 as per Hindu rites This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/11/2025 at 22:31:32 and ceremonies.

One male child, namely, Daksh, was born out of the said wedlock on 04.07.2019,
who is presently in the custody of respondent no. 2.

It is stated that on the complaint of respondent Vijay Kumar & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr on 4 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67008678/
1 no. 2, the present FIR was registered against the petitioners.

entities.text: Vijay Kumar & Ors vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
During pendency of the case, both the parties had amicably settled their disputes vide Memorandum of Understanding dated 29.08.2025,
entered between them.

5. On a query made by this Court, respondent no.2, who has been identified by the IO, has categorically stated that she has entered into compromise out of her own free will and without any pressure, coercion or threat.
Respondent no. 2 states that she has no objection, if the present FIR is quashed.

6. The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the affidavits showing the protection of interest of minor child, as per the judgment titled as Ganesh vs. Sudhirkumar Shrivastava: (2020)
20 SCC 787 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court, have been filed and the same are on record.
It is stated that the custody of the minor child is with respondent no. 2 and the future rights of the child will not be affected by virtue of the aforesaid settlement agreement.

7. In view of the above fact that the parties have amicably resolved their differences of their own free will, and without any coercion, no useful purpose will be served by continuing the proceedings,
rather the same would create further acrimony between them.
It would thus be in interest of justice to quash the abovementioned FIR and the proceedings pursuant thereto.
There is no legal impediment in quashing the FIR in question.
8. Accordingly, FIR bearing no. 450/2016, registered at Police Station Govindpuri, South East District, New Delhi, for the commission of offence This is a digitally signed order.

entities.text: Police Station Govindpuri, South East District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 07/11/2025 at 22:31:32 punishable under Sections 498A/406/506/34 of IPC and all consequential proceedings emanating therefrom are quashed.
9. In view of above, the present petition stands disposed of.
10. The order be uploaded on the website forthwith.
DR. SWARANA KANTA SHARMA, J NOVEMBER 4, 2025/A
